### When Leadership Is Lacking
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/when-leadership-is-lacking-one-year-devotions-for-men-april-21.html
Passage: Ezekiel 34:3
Points:
- Throughout history, corrupt rulers have abused power by hoarding wealth while neglecting the people they were charged to protect.
- God condemns Israel's leaders for consuming the flock's milk and wool while allowing the sheep to wander and starve.
- The Lord declares Himself an enemy to self-serving shepherds and holds them accountable for the harm done to His people.
- Anyone placed in leadership—including a husband in the home—must serve selflessly rather than exploit others for personal gain.

### Bible Pathway - September 10
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-sept-10-2013.html
Passage: Ezekiel 34:2, 4
Points:
- God delivers a direct reproof against leaders who look after only themselves and rule with harshness.
- The passage lists essential pastoral responsibilities, including strengthening the weak, healing the sick, and recovering the lost.
- Churches can use Ezekiel's criteria to identify true servant-leaders rather than those seeking an easy, part-time position.
- Caring for Christ's flock is a weighty responsibility that requires earnest prayer and dedicated support from the congregation.
